intro.en: Custom waterproof wire harnesses are developed as complete sealed systems. Connector interfaces, wire seals, cavity plugs, cable entries, branches, strain relief, routing and validation are coordinated around the real exposure.
intro.zh: 定制防水设计线束需要作为完整密封系统开发。连接器接口、单线密封、堵孔件、出线、分支、应力消除、布线路径与验证，都要围绕真实暴露环境协同定义。

knowledge.en: IP67, IP68 and IP69K describe different defined test conditions; none is a universal synonym for waterproof, and a component rating does not automatically transfer to a finished harness.
knowledge.zh: IP67、IP68 与 IP69K 对应不同的规定试验条件，并不是“防水”的通用同义词；元件等级也不会自动转移到整条成品线束。

notes.en: Provide both mating interfaces, pin map, cable and insulation diameters, unused cavities, installation orientation, water source, temperature, fluids, movement and the required test method and acceptance limits.
notes.zh: 请提供对插两端、针脚表、线缆与绝缘外径、空腔、安装方向、水源、温度、介质、运动条件，以及所需试验方法与验收限值。

delivery.en: The released configuration records the complete sealing stack, preparation dimensions, assembly controls and agreed electrical and ingress evidence. Performance claims remain limited to that validated configuration.
delivery.zh: 放行配置会记录完整密封链、备线尺寸、装配控制，以及约定的电气与防护证据；性能结论仅适用于经过验证的该项配置。

subtitle.zh: 水会沿着每一条未封闭路径前进

lead.en: A sealed connector is only one link. The complete cable assembly must control the mating face, rear wire entry, unused cavities, branches, jacket transitions, movement and installed drainage as one continuous waterproof boundary.
lead.zh: 密封连接器只是其中一环。完整线束必须把对插面、尾部入线、空腔、分支、护套过渡、运动受力与装机排水作为一条连续防水边界来控制。

title.en: Waterproofing Is a System, Not a Connector Label
title.zh: 防水是一套系统，不是连接器标签

copy.en: Custom waterproof wire harnesses and sealed cable assemblies may connect sensors, lamps, pumps, valves, controllers, motors or service ports. Water can enter through an incompletely mated interface, a damaged perimeter seal, an incorrect wire seal, an empty cavity, an undersized cable gland, an unsealed splice or a jacket transition under bending load. Design begins by drawing the entire ingress boundary and naming the condition in which it must work—mated, capped, panel-installed or connected to the final equipment.
copy.zh: 定制防水线束与密封电缆组件可连接传感器、灯具、泵、阀、控制器、电机或维修接口。水可能从未完全插合的接口、受损周边密封、错误线封、空孔、尺寸不合的格兰头、未密封接点，或承受弯曲载荷的护套过渡处进入。设计首先要画出完整进水边界，并说明它必须在哪种状态工作：已对插、已加盖、已装面板，还是已连接最终设备。

title.en: IP67, IP68 and IP69K Are Different Test Questions
title.zh: IP67、IP68 与 IP69K 回答的是不同试验问题

copy.en: IEC 60529 classifies degrees of protection provided by enclosures, but an IP code only has meaning with a defined specimen and method. Temporary immersion, deeper or longer immersion, and close-range high-pressure wash are not interchangeable duties. For vehicles, customer specifications or ISO 20653 may define another route. We therefore record target depth, duration, pressure, nozzle direction, temperature, conditioning and pass criteria instead of advertising one IP number for every waterproof connector harness.
copy.zh: IEC 60529 用于划分外壳提供的防护等级，但 IP 代码只有结合规定试样与方法才有意义。短时浸水、更深或更久的浸水、近距离高压冲洗并不是可以互换的工况；车辆项目还可能依据客户规范或 ISO 20653 采用另一套路径。因此，我们会记录目标深度、时间、压力、喷嘴方向、温度、预处理与合格条件，而不是给所有防水连接器线束套用同一个 IP 数字。

title.en: Housing Seal, Wire Seal and Cavity Plug Must Work Together
title.zh: 壳体密封、单线密封与堵孔件必须协同工作

copy.en: A sealed connector system combines the housing, terminals, interface seal, individual wire seals or mat seal, secondary lock and specified cavity plugs. Each wire seal must match the real insulation diameter and the terminal crimp range; copper size alone is insufficient. Unused cavities receive the correct plug, not adhesive or an improvised filler. Familiar systems such as TE AMPSEAL, AMP SUPERSEAL, DEUTSCH DT/DTM/DTP, Molex MX150 and sealed M8/M12 interfaces still require exact part-number and mating-state confirmation.
copy.zh: 密封连接器系统由壳体、端子、接口密封、单线密封或整体线封、二次锁止与规定堵孔件组成。每个线封都要匹配真实绝缘外径与端子压接范围，只看铜线截面并不够；未使用孔位应安装正确堵头，不能用胶或临时填充替代。TE AMPSEAL、AMP SUPERSEAL、DEUTSCH DT/DTM/DTP、Molex MX150，以及密封 M8/M12 等常见体系，仍然需要核对准确料号与插合状态。

title.en: Cable Glands and Rear Entries Need a Defined Compression Window
title.zh: 格兰头与尾部出线需要明确压缩窗口

copy.en: A cable gland, rear grommet, backshell or molded boot seals only when its clamping range matches the finished jacket diameter and roundness. Braid build-up, labels, corrugated tube and branch transitions can change that diameter locally. Tightening torque, panel thread, gasket, wall thickness, rear bend radius and cable weight all affect the installed seal. The cable should leave the entry without side-loading it, and clamps or service loops should carry movement before it reaches the sealing lips.
copy.zh: 格兰头、尾部胶塞、尾壳或模压护套，只有在夹紧范围匹配成品护套外径与圆度时才能密封。编织增厚、标签、波纹管和分支过渡都会局部改变直径；锁紧扭矩、面板螺纹、垫片、壁厚、尾部弯曲半径与线缆重量也会影响装机密封。出线不应持续侧向拉扯密封件，运动载荷应先由卡箍或维修余量承担。

title.en: Sealed Splices Must Stop Moisture and Strand Migration
title.zh: 密封接点还要阻止水分沿导体迁移

copy.en: Water does not need a visible opening to travel. Moisture can migrate along stranded conductors from a wet branch to a protected enclosure. Sealed crimp splices, solder-seal sleeves, adhesive-lined heat shrink, molded breakouts or potted junctions are selected from current, conductor combination, geometry, flexibility, repair policy and exposure. The joint still needs controlled stripping, conductor support and inspection; a clear sleeve may show the connection but does not by itself prove a watertight seal.
copy.zh: 水不需要肉眼可见的大开口也能前进，湿气可沿多股导体从潮湿分支迁移到受保护箱体。密封压接接点、焊锡密封套管、带胶热缩、模压分支或灌封接线点，需要依据电流、导体组合、几何、柔性、维修策略与暴露环境选择。接点仍须控制剥线、导体支撑与检验；透明套管能够展示内部连接，但本身不能证明水密。

title.en: Adhesive-Lined Heat Shrink Needs Surface and Geometry Control
title.zh: 带胶热缩需要控制表面与几何

copy.en: Dual-wall heat-shrink tubing can seal a local transition when shrink ratio, recovered diameter, adhesive flow, overlap, surface cleanliness and heating profile are compatible. It performs poorly over sharp steps, contaminated jackets, irregular bundles or a cable that keeps flexing at the sleeve edge. Tubing should not obstruct a connector latch or create a rigid hinge. Material names such as polyolefin, FEP or elastomer do not replace a project-specific temperature, fluid and adhesion review.
copy.zh: 双壁带胶热缩管在收缩倍率、恢复内径、胶流动、搭接长度、表面洁净度与加热曲线相容时，可用于密封局部过渡。面对尖锐台阶、受污染护套、不规则线束，或持续在套管边缘弯折的线缆时，效果会显著下降；套管也不能阻碍锁扣或形成刚性折点。聚烯烃、FEP、弹性体等材料名称，不能替代项目特定的温度、介质与粘接审核。

title.en: Overmolding and Potting Depend on Adhesion, Not Appearance
title.zh: 包胶与灌封依靠粘接体系，而不是外观

copy.en: Overmolded waterproof cables and potted cable assemblies can close complex exits, protect solder joints and create strain relief, but resin must bond to the real jacket, insert and housing surfaces. Mold pressure, venting, preheating, cure, voids, contamination and thermal expansion affect the hidden interface. A smooth molding can still contain a capillary path. Sample validation should therefore use production-intent materials, tooling and conditioning, with the result limited to that exact construction.
copy.zh: 防水包胶电缆与灌封线束可封闭复杂出线、保护焊点并形成应力消除，但树脂必须能与真实护套、嵌件和壳体表面形成可靠粘接。模压压力、排气、预热、固化、气泡、污染与热膨胀都会影响隐藏界面；表面光滑的包胶内部仍可能存在毛细通道。因此，样品验证应使用接近量产的材料、模具与预处理，结论只适用于该准确结构。

title.en: Temperature Cycling Can Pull Moisture Through a Good-Looking Seal
title.zh: 温度循环会让看似完好的密封承受呼吸效应

copy.en: Outdoor equipment heats during operation and cools after shutdown. Changing internal pressure, condensation, seal compression set and jacket movement can expose leak paths that a room-temperature splash check misses. Routes should avoid upward-facing cavities and water traps, include deliberate drip loops or drainage where appropriate, and separate vents from cable seals. UV, salt, fuel, oil, coolant and cleaning agents are reviewed independently because resistance to water does not prove compatibility with every fluid.
copy.zh: 户外设备工作时升温、停机后降温，内部压力变化、冷凝、密封压缩永久变形与护套移动，可能暴露室温喷淋检查发现不了的泄漏路径。布线应避免接口朝上与积水陷阱，并按需要设置滴水弯或排水，同时把通气方案与线缆密封分开考虑。紫外、盐、燃油、润滑油、冷却液与清洁剂还要分别审核，因为耐水不等于兼容所有介质。

title.en: Agriculture and Mobile Machinery: Mud, Vibration and Field Service
title.zh: 农业与移动机械：泥水、振动与现场维修

copy.en: Agricultural, construction and material-handling machines combine mud, standing water, vibration, branch movement and frequent service. A harness may need sealed DEUTSCH-style interfaces, abrasion-resistant covering, supported breakouts, replaceable sensor branches and labels that remain legible after cleaning. Connector orientation and drainage are planned with the machine route. The image represents wet-duty context; actual protection still depends on the released assembly and validation method.
copy.zh: 农业、工程与物料搬运设备会同时面对泥水、积水、振动、分支运动与频繁维修。线束可能需要密封 DEUTSCH 类接口、耐磨覆盖、受支撑分支、可更换传感器支路，以及清洗后仍清晰的标识；接口方向与排水应结合整机路径规划。图片用于表达湿作业环境，实际防护仍取决于放行结构与验证方法。

title.en: Marine and Coastal Equipment: Water Is Only One Material Risk
title.zh: 船用与沿海设备：水只是材料风险之一

copy.en: Marine wiring harnesses, outboard controls, pumps, deck equipment and coastal instruments can face salt, spray, condensation, galvanic corrosion, sunlight and long idle periods. Sealing must be coordinated with conductor plating, contact finish, shell material, fasteners, cable jacket, grounding and drainage. A connector advertised for outdoor use is not automatically suitable for every marine zone or ignition-protected installation; the governing equipment rules and customer specification remain decisive.
copy.zh: 船用线束、舷外机控制、泵、甲板设备与沿海仪器可能面对盐雾、飞溅、冷凝、电偶腐蚀、日照与长期停机。密封必须与导体镀层、触点表面、壳体材料、紧固件、护套、接地与排水协同。标注户外使用的接口并不会自动适用于所有船用区域或点火防护安装，最终仍以整机规则与客户规范为准。

title.en: Washdown Equipment: Direction, Distance and Temperature Matter
title.zh: 冲洗设备：喷射方向、距离与温度都很重要

copy.en: Food processing, packaging, water treatment and industrial cleaning can expose equipment to repeated jets, hot water, detergents or disinfectants. Pressure-wash resistance depends on nozzle distance, angle, pressure, flow, temperature, duration and the state of every cap and mating interface. Cable routes should keep water from collecting behind boots and covers. Routine production inspection checks seal presence and assembly; agreed spray or immersion testing uses defined fixtures and samples rather than an uncontrolled hose test.
copy.zh: 食品加工、包装、水处理与工业清洗设备可能反复承受水柱、热水、清洁剂或消毒剂。抗冲洗能力取决于喷嘴距离、角度、压力、流量、温度、时间，以及每个防护帽和对插接口的状态；走线应避免水积存在护套与盖板之后。日常生产检查核对密封件与装配，约定的喷淋或浸水试验则使用规定夹具与试样，而不是随意用水管冲一下。

inputs.en: Exact connector housings, terminals, mating parts, seals, plugs and caps
inputs.zh: 准确连接器壳体、端子、对插件、密封、堵头与防护帽

inputs.en: Pin map, conductor size, insulation and finished cable diameters, shields and branches
inputs.zh: 针脚表、导体规格、绝缘与成品外径、屏蔽和分支

inputs.en: Mated, capped, panel-installed or final-equipment test state
inputs.zh: 对插、加盖、面板安装或最终装机测试状态

inputs.en: Rain, splash, immersion, washdown, condensation, mud, salt and chemical exposure
inputs.zh: 雨淋、飞溅、浸水、冲洗、冷凝、泥污、盐与化学暴露

inputs.en: Temperature, movement, clamp locations, route orientation, drainage and service needs
inputs.zh: 温度、运动、卡箍位置、布线方向、排水与维修需求

inputs.en: Required standard or customer method, conditioning, sample quantity and acceptance limits
inputs.zh: 所需标准或客户方法、预处理、样品数量与验收限值

q.en: Does an IP67 connector make the whole harness IP67?
q.zh: 使用 IP67 连接器就能让整条线束达到 IP67 吗？

a.en: No. The complete mated interface, wire seals, cavity plugs, cable entries, branches, equipment-side parts, installed orientation and test condition determine the result.
a.zh: 不能。完整对插接口、线封、堵头、出线、分支、设备端零件、安装方向与试验条件共同决定结果。

q.en: What is the difference between IP67, IP68 and IP69K?
q.zh: IP67、IP68 与 IP69K 有什么区别？

a.en: They address different defined water-exposure tests. Depth, duration, pressure, temperature and specimen state must be read from the applicable standard or project specification; the numbers are not interchangeable quality grades.
a.zh: 它们对应不同的规定水暴露试验。深度、时间、压力、温度与试样状态必须从适用标准或项目规范中读取，数字不是可以互换的品质等级。

q.en: Can you build waterproof harnesses with DEUTSCH, AMPSEAL, SUPERSEAL or M12 connectors?
q.zh: 可以使用 DEUTSCH、AMPSEAL、SUPERSEAL 或 M12 制作防水线束吗？

a.en: Yes, around exact approved part numbers and mating interfaces. Housing, terminal, seal, plug, wire range, cap and assembly instructions must remain compatible as one system.
a.zh: 可以，但必须围绕批准的准确料号与对插接口开发，并确保壳体、端子、密封、堵头、线径、防护帽与装配要求构成兼容系统。

q.en: Can branches and splices be made waterproof?
q.zh: 分支与接点可以做防水吗？

a.en: They can be designed for a defined exposure using sealed splices, adhesive-lined heat shrink, molded breakouts or potted junctions. Geometry, repairability and validation determine the method.
a.zh: 可针对规定暴露采用密封接点、带胶热缩、模压分支或灌封接线点；具体方法取决于几何、可维修性与验证要求。

a.en: No. Adhesion to the actual jacket and insert, molding quality, void control, mating condition and the complete tested boundary determine performance.
a.zh: 不会。对真实护套与嵌件的粘接、成型质量、气泡控制、对插状态与完整受测边界共同决定性能。

q.en: Which information is needed for a waterproof harness quotation?
q.zh: 防水线束报价需要哪些资料？

a.en: Send both mating interfaces, circuit map, wire and cable diameters, unused cavities, installation and route, real exposure, movement, materials or fluids, quantity and required test evidence.
a.zh: 请提供对插两端、回路图、线材与电缆外径、空腔、安装与路径、真实暴露、运动、材料或介质、数量和所需测试证据。
